name: The Cormorant Testimonies
description: A banned neural-feed documentary in which viewers directly inhabit the recorded memories — legally extracted and then illegally distributed — of eleven survivors of HelixCorp's 2208 Cormorant District forced relocation. The immersive testimony format means audiences experience displacement, violence, and bureaucratic erasure in first person. Runtime varies per testimony strand, averaging 67 minutes per subject.
cultural_impact: Considered the most important documentary of the 2210s by underground press, credited with radicalizing an entire cohort of Tier 3 workers who had previously considered HelixCorp moderate.
story_hooks: One of the eleven testimony strands contains a memory that appears to have been surgically altered — someone edited a face out of every recollection before distribution
A HelixCorp fixer is quietly hunting the anonymous editor who assembled the film, and has started working backward through the underground distribution network
A player character who experiences the film begins having memory bleed — fragments of the testimonies surfacing in their own neural feed at unexpected moments
